manifest.selection: Train A/B stress only; maximize worst return, then sum; current wins ties.
manifest.gate: Finalist positive and unhalted in both full/validation and baseline/stress; return >= reference; DD <= reference+2pp. No automatic activation.
manifest.limitations: Previously inspected data, NOT untouched holdout. Historical filters not available. Same 3x80 portfolio and fixed risk. No future-profit guarantee.
